summary: Root-wave bundle: two plugin marketplace manifests plus the Whiteboard desktop shell, a Code OSS fork under vs/review. Covers the canvas editor pane, which mounts the React canvas bundle behind a bridge, the fixed-grid workbench, and common helpers: loopback server discovery, SSE reader with size guard, reconnect backoff, error-report limiter, structural-diff fold and lens projection math, viewed-coverage progress. Tiers are mostly dashboard-kit, daemon and hitl, with some none; no agent logic appears here.
